notes: For n <= 400 and all k >= 0, the only zeros of B_k(n) = sum_j C(k,j) tau(n-j) and S_k(n) = sum_j C(k-1+j,j) tau(n-j) are B_24(2), S_24(2), S_23(4) (integer roots of the degree n-1 polynomials in k, PARI nfroots); direct scan k <= 300, n <= 3000 agrees. The known zeros are vanishing x^1 / x^3 coefficients of (1-x^2)^48 prod_{m>=3}(1-x^m)^24 and (1-x) prod_{m>=2}(1-x^m)^24. The full claim contains Lehmer's conjecture at k = 0.
